tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Primary ground: the night sky of the gallery. Page background; text on star-yellow fills.

tokens.name: deep-blue
tokens.usage: Dark surface one step above midnight: cards, panels and artwork labels.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surface: hover, inputs and image mats.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Selected surfaces (active tab, chosen filter). Ivory text on indigo is 9.3:1.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Restrained interactive accent: secondary button fill. Ivory on cobalt is 4.6:1; cobalt itself is only 3.3:1 on midnight, so never cobalt text.

tokens.name: muted-sky
tokens.usage: Accent text and links (6.7:1 on midnight, 5.1:1 on night-raised). Eyebrows, active nav, link labels.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Secondary text (8.1:1 on midnight, 6.1:1 on night-raised). Captions and metadata.

tokens.name: star-yellow
tokens.usage: The thread. Logo thread, the Long Thread, one important detail per screen, the single primary button fill. Never a large background and never body text.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Warm ivory: primary text and the frame of the symbol. Never pure white.

tokens.name: madder-light
tokens.usage: Signal red for errors (7.2:1 on midnight). Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, artwork labels, collection cards. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover, inputs, the card above a surface. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected state (active filter, current tab). Text on it: on-selected.

tokens.name: on-selected
tokens.usage: Text on surface-selected (9.3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-raised (11:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on bg, surface and surface-raised (6.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Fine rules and separators (decorative, 0.5-1px). Not for the border of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons and chips: 3:1 or more on bg and surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent text, links and labels on bg and surface (5.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: interactive
tokens.usage: Fill of a secondary interactive control. Pair with on-interactive.

tokens.name: on-interactive
tokens.usage: Text on interactive (4.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill for the single primary button on a screen. Pair with on-accent. Never a large area.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-fill (10.9:1).

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: The thread: graphic lines, dividers with a crossing, the symbol thread. Decorative, never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset: 3:1 or more on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on bg and surface. Always with a word.

styles.name: display-ar
styles.usage: Arabic hero headline. One per screen, 2 lines at most. No letter-spacing, ever.
styles.sample: كل لوحة خيط في حكاية الفن

styles.name: display-en
styles.usage: Latin hero headline, sentence case. Light optical weight, slight positive tracking.

styles.name: heading-ar-1
styles.usage: Page and section titles in Arabic (artist name, collection title).

styles.name: heading-en-1
styles.usage: Page and section titles in English.

styles.name: artwork-title-ar
styles.usage: Artwork title in cards and labels (Arabic).

styles.name: body-ar
styles.usage: Arabic reading text: biographies, artwork essays, historical notes. Line height 1.8 is the floor.
styles.sample: تُعدّ اللوحة «ترونيًا»، أي دراسة لملامح الوجه، لا بورتريهًا لشخص معروف.

styles.name: body-en
styles.usage: English reading text. Set in Scheherazade New's Latin so mixed Arabic and English lines share one colour.
styles.sample: A tronie is a study of a face, not a portrait of a known sitter.

styles.name: poetic-ar
styles.usage: Short poetic statements introducing an artwork. Maximum two lines, never in UI chrome.

styles.name: ui-ar
styles.usage: Navigation, buttons and form labels in Arabic. No letter-spacing.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata: date, medium, dimensions, collection. Western digits.

styles.name: eyebrow-en
styles.usage: English uppercase label. Always tracked at 0.18em, never used for Arabic.

styles.name: wordmark-en
styles.usage: English WASHIJ wordmark: uppercase Cormorant, tracking 0.32em. Use the supplied lockup, do not retype it at body sizes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter. Inner padding of compact cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between grid items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter, gap between sections of a card.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between content blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero and page-opening padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Frames, artwork, cards, buttons: the default. Paintings have corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and chips only when a hard corner clashes with the context.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars and the app icon mask only.

tokens.name: shadow-hang
tokens.usage: The only shadow: an artwork hanging off a wall. Never on UI cards.
